verdict.rationale: Motion documents its own voice-based task creation, with tasks then auto-scheduled (motion-docs-17), and an AI Search Assistant that finds docs, notes, projects and tasks (motion-docs-22). This is natural-language input, but it is limited to creating tasks and searching, not general operation of the product. The Siri route (motion-docs-20) is a host-platform capability and earns no credit. missing for 10: a general natural-language command or chat interface for operating scheduling, projects and settings, documented NL command scope and examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
